# India Today

> India Today is a major Indian news platform covering breaking news, politics, business, cricket, entertainment, technology, and world affairs.

The site publishes fast-moving news updates, explainers, opinion, videos, live TV, and magazine content across national, state, and international beats. It also operates dedicated sections for sports, business, education, lifestyle, and fact-checking.

## Top-Level News

- [Home](https://www.indiatoday.in): Main news homepage with breaking headlines across India, world, business, sports, and entertainment.
- [Latest News](https://www.indiatoday.in/latest-news): Rolling stream of the newest stories and breaking developments.
- [India](https://www.indiatoday.in/india): National news coverage on politics, policy, crime, governance, and major events.
- [World](https://www.indiatoday.in/world): International news, geopolitics, conflicts, diplomacy, and global developments.
- [News Analysis](https://www.indiatoday.in/news-analysis): Deeper reporting and analytical takes on major current affairs stories.
- [Fact Check](https://www.indiatoday.in/fact-check): Verification-focused reporting that examines viral claims, misinformation, and manipulated content.

## Politics & Elections

- [Politics](https://www.indiatoday.in/politics): Coverage of parties, leaders, Parliament, campaigns, and political strategy.
- [Elections](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections): National and state election coverage with results, schedules, and campaign updates.
- [India News](https://www.indiatoday.in/india): Reporting on government decisions, law and order, and public policy.
- [UP News](https://www.indiatoday.in/india/uttar-pradesh): State-focused coverage from Uttar Pradesh politics and public affairs.
- [Tamil Nadu News](https://www.indiatoday.in/india/tamil-nadu): News and political developments from Tamil Nadu.
- [West Bengal News](https://www.indiatoday.in/india/west-bengal): Coverage of politics, governance, and major stories from West Bengal.

## Business & Economy

- [Business](https://www.indiatoday.in/business): Business news on markets, economy, companies, and consumer trends.
- [Market](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/market): Stock market coverage including Sensex, Nifty, and trading updates.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/personal-finance): Reporting on savings, taxes, investing, loans, and money management.
- [Budget](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/budget): Union Budget coverage, tax changes, and policy implications.
- [Companies](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/companies): Corporate news, earnings, leadership changes, and sector developments.
- [Start-up](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/start-up): Startup ecosystem coverage including funding, founders, and product launches.

## Sports & Cricket

- [Sports](https://www.indiatoday.in/sports): Broad sports coverage including cricket, football, tennis, and Olympic disciplines.
- [Cricket](https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/cricket): Match news, series coverage, player updates, and tournament reporting.
- [IPL](https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/ipl-2025): Indian Premier League coverage with fixtures, analysis, and team news.
- [Football](https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/football): Football news covering leagues, tournaments, and player developments.
- [Tennis](https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/tennis): Tennis reporting on tours, Grand Slams, and player performances.
- [Other Sports](https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/other-sports): Coverage of badminton, wrestling, athletics, and more.

## Entertainment

- [Entertainment](https://www.indiatoday.in/entertainment): Film, television, OTT, celebrity, and pop culture coverage.
- [Bollywood](https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/bollywood): Hindi film industry news, releases, interviews, and box office updates.
- [Hollywood](https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/hollywood): International film news, trailers, reviews, and celebrity coverage.
- [Television](https://www.indiatoday.in/television): TV industry news, serial updates, reality shows, and cast interviews.
- [OTT](https://www.indiatoday.in/binge-watch): Streaming-focused coverage of web series, films, and platform releases.
- [Celebrities](https://www.indiatoday.in/celebrities): Celebrity news, interviews, appearances, and social media moments.

## Technology & Science

- [Technology](https://www.indiatoday.in/technology): Tech news covering gadgets, apps, AI, telecom, and digital policy.
- [Science](https://www.indiatoday.in/science): Reporting on space, research, environment, and scientific discoveries.
- [Mobile Phones](https://www.indiatoday.in/technology/mobile): Smartphone launches, reviews, comparisons, and mobile ecosystem news.
- [Laptops & PCs](https://www.indiatoday.in/technology/laptops-pc): Coverage of laptops, desktops, chips, and computing products.
- [NewsMo](https://www.indiatoday.in/newsmo): Internet culture, social trends, and youth-focused digital stories.
- [India Today NE](https://www.indiatodayne.in): Northeast-focused news portal covering regional politics, society, and current affairs.

## Lifestyle, Health & Education

- [Lifestyle](https://www.indiatoday.in/lifestyle): Features on fashion, food, travel, relationships, and culture.
- [Health](https://www.indiatoday.in/health): Health reporting on medicine, wellness, diseases, and public health issues.
- [Education Today](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today): Education news on exams, admissions, careers, and policy changes.
- [Information](https://www.indiatoday.in/information): Utility-focused explainers, how-tos, and public information articles.
- [Travel](https://www.indiatoday.in/lifestyle/travel): Travel stories, destination features, and tourism updates.
- [Food & Drink](https://www.indiatoday.in/lifestyle/food): Food trends, recipes, restaurant stories, and culinary features.

## Video, TV & Multimedia

- [Live TV](https://www.indiatoday.in/livetv): Live streaming of India Today television news coverage.
- [Videos](https://www.indiatoday.in/videos): Video reports, interviews, explainers, and news clips.
- [Programmes](https://www.indiatoday.in/programmes): India Today TV shows and program pages.
- [News Today](https://www.indiatoday.in/programmes/news-today): Program page for the News Today television show.
- [To The Point](https://www.indiatoday.in/programmes/to-the-point): Debate and analysis show page with recent episodes and clips.
- [5ive Live](https://www.indiatoday.in/programmes/5ive-live): Program page for short-format live news coverage.

## Opinion, Magazine & Special Content

- [Opinion](https://www.indiatoday.in/opinion): Columns, editorials, and commentary from writers and guest contributors.
- [India Today Magazine](https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine): Magazine stories, cover packages, and long-form reporting.
- [Specials](https://www.indiatoday.in/specials): Curated special coverage pages for major events and themes.
- [Data Intelligence Unit](https://www.indiatoday.in/diu): Data-driven journalism, charts, and evidence-based analysis.
- [India Today Insight](https://www.indiatoday.in/india-today-insight): Subscriber-style explainers and deeper context on current affairs.
- [Sunday Special](https://www.indiatoday.in/sunday-special): Weekend long reads, profiles, and feature stories.

## Utility & Platform Pages

- [Search](https://www.indiatoday.in/search/site): Site search for articles, topics, and archived coverage.
- [Coronavirus](https://www.indiatoday.in/coronavirus-outbreak): Archived pandemic coverage, updates, and explainers.
- [RSS Feeds](https://www.indiatoday.in/rss): RSS feed directory for following India Today content streams.
- [Contact Us](https://www.indiatoday.in/contactus): Contact information and editorial or business inquiry details.
- [About Us](https://www.indiatoday.in/about-us): Corporate and editorial background for the India Today network.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.indiatoday.in/privacy-policy): Privacy practices and data handling policy for site users.
